answer: Every identity mints a TEE attestation key: a hardware quote binding one agent to one physical secure enclave, re-quoted every 24h. A sybil farm runs out of real chips, so the tenth clone costs more than the first nine combined - per-identity cost goes convex, while honest agents pay once. Quorum peers echo each quote hash into a rolling harbor ledger; a dune of clones sharing one chip serial is slashed, any agent can forfeit-signal a 5% random canary re-quote. Lose the enclave, forfeit the bond.
